limitations: This standard-library sandbox demonstrates declared-input isolation, not OS-level process, network, clock, or syscall isolation.
retrieval_method: Python 3 standard-library HTTPS GET with a descriptive research user agent; redirect target recorded.

source.admitted_claim: A hermetic build has no influences other than its explicit inputs, which helps isolate changes in source inputs from changes in the build system.
